title: Implement production GPU backends for all code types
description:
Conditional on the HIP/ROCm GPU feasibility decision (epic `806eb14e`: GO for LDPC BP and BCH syndrome). Extend the HIP/ROCm backend in `gf2-kernels-hip` across code types (LDPC, BCH, Viterbi). Optimize memory layout (SoA for coalesced access). Implement automatic CPU/GPU backend selection with fallback. Vulkan and CUDA backends are superseded and out of scope (see `dev/plans/hip_gpu_prototype_wave.md`). Target: 500-1000 Mbps LDPC decoding.

Reframed 2026-06-17 from the obsolete Vulkan/CUDA plan to HIP/ROCm per the epic 806eb14e feasibility decision (user-approved).
